prompt:
Create TC-SKIN-A / Town Center Flat Material Sources in the existing Civilization Town Living Settlement project. This is a MATERIAL SOURCE review board for the first town_center building in BLDG-01, NOT a new building design or gameplay dashboard. Reference the existing ancient architecture IMAGE screen projects/9572784485551125903/screens/5eaec90d6212477cb95917458d523044 and architecture board 6b607d23787a40d38985f0024e5bcfaa. Preserve that specific ancient town hall's pixel-art material craftsmanship; the user already likes its geometry.

PLATFORM: Desktop static art-library review.

PAGE STRUCTURE:
1. Compact title "Town Center / Flat Material Sources" with "Stage A - material review only".
2. Five large separate original raster IMAGE assets, each downloadable independently, each ideally 512x512 pixels or larger. Arrange in an uncluttered grid, labels and descriptions OUTSIDE the image pixels:
  a. straw_grain: close, flat surface detail of dried roof straw fibres, all fibres running vertically. Fine varied clustered strands, small natural interruptions. NO complete roof, sheaf silhouette, horizontal roof courses, rope, gaps showing a background, ridge, roof edge, or baked large directional shadow. Geometry already makes the bundles and roof layers.
  b. oak_grain: close flat aged oak beam surface; grain runs vertically along the beam; fine irregular annual growth and occasional understated knot. NO joined boards, plank gaps, screws, metal, cut log end, frame, border, or raised slab.
  c. limestone_grain: uniform close surface of ONE warm weathered limestone block with small chisel marks, restrained pores and subtle wear. NO brick arrangement, grout, masonry courses, tile divisions, slab silhouette or stone pile. Geometry already supplies individual bricks.
  d. plaster_grain: uniform flat dried light wall plaster surface matching the town hall infill, faint uneven hand-trowel marks and sparse gentle age mottling. NO timber framing, door, window, crack shaped like text, wall edge or strongly vignetted gradient.
  e. linen_weave: close flat cloth material matching the Town Center hanging banners, a subtle visible woven warp/weft. NO banner shape, pole, fringe, folds, stitched emblem, lettering, trim or broad shadow; the mesh already supplies the banner and motif.
3. A small exact Town Center reference image from the existing architecture master may appear BELOW the swatches, clearly outside every material image.
4. Minimal descriptions stating fibre orientation and that repeating seams remain unverified.

IMAGE REQUIREMENTS:
- Actual ORIGINAL raster images that can be inspected/downloaded separately, not CSS fills, CSS patterns, SVG drawings, icons, photographs or placeholders.
- Strictly orthographic, straight-on, planar surface with even front illumination. Fill every image edge to edge with its material. No isometric perspective, no thickness, no mockup slab, no presentation frame, no label, no board background, no checkerboard.
- Retain the existing illustrated pixel clusters and material character of BLDG-01; not photorealistic texture photography, glossy 3D rendering or random noisy speckles. Material detail should survive moderate reduction.
- Create visually uniform edge-to-edge candidates, but do not claim mathematically seamless tiles or UV-ready meshes. No animation.
- This board prepares source materials only. Do not change any existing screen or design system, and do not overwrite the architecture master.
- Please include five real independent material image assets in the generated HTML. No website menus, statistics, navigation sidebar, cards imitating texture art, or marketing content.
